# Perfect List of Dog Names From Movies

Written by The Right Bite Team

![](https://www.raisedrightpets.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/shutterstock_1563714109.jpg.webp)

So you got yourself a little furry friend, but don’t know what to name them? Well, if you are an avid movie fan, then you have come to the right place! We’ve gathered here a very unique list of dog names from movies. It’s a mixed bag of things, so you will find your perfect fit for sure!

Let’s see those names!

## **Famous Dog Names From Movies**

Of course, let’s begin by mentioning the most famous dog names from movies. These are the classic, and if you love classics – well, then you are in for a treat!

- **Beethoven** – a St. Bernard dog from Beethoven movie
- **Benji** – from the 1974 movie Benji
- **Blanche**– from A Streetcar Named Desire
- **Rhett** – from It’s a Wonderful life
- **Bolt –** From the animated movie Bolt
- **Clifford –** from the ‘Clifford’s Really Big Movie’
- **Einstein –** from Back to the Future
- **Fly –** from Babe
- **Wednesday –** from The Addams Family
- **Old Yeller –** from Old Yeller
- **Thelma – from Thelma and Louise**
- **Petey –** from ‘The Little Rascals’
- **Pitty, Peat or Pete –** after the unnamed pit bull from John Wick
- **Rin Tin Tin –** after the movie ‘The Adventures of Rin Tin Tin’
- **Samantha –** from ‘I Am Legend’
- **Scarlett** – from Gone With the Wind
- **Vito** – from The Godfather
- **Slinky –** from the Toy Story movies
- **Eddie Crane (or Eddie or Crane) –** from the movie ‘Frasier’

![dog](https://www.raisedrightpets.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/shutterstock_1841439757-1.jpg.webp)

Dogs are wonderful characters. That’s why we love them. So, is it any wonder there are so many cartoon canines? From Scooby to Snoopy, the world of digitized doggies is an excellent place to find a name for your new pooch. Best of all, we’ve done all the research for you.

We’ve compiled the complete list of **cartoon dog names** for your ins- _paw_-ration, sourcing ideas from nostalgic comics and shows to modern animations and movies. By the end, you’ll know exactly which name to pick for your pup, whether they’re a stylish superhero or _furry-tail_ princess.

- Angel ( _Lady and the Tramp 2)_
- Gromit _(Wallace and Gromit)_
- Dixie _(The Fox and the Hound 2)_
- Annette _(Lady and the Tramp)_
- Belle _(The Secret Life of Pets)_
- Georgette _(Oliver & Company)_
- Missy _(Clifford the Big Red Dog)_
- Lila _(Hey Arnold!)_

Dogs are nothing if not cute. The same can be said about our cartoon canine characters – their loveable faces and wagging tails have kept us two-leggers smiling for generations. Why not take your doggy’s adorable levels to dizzying heights with one of these **animated dog character** names?

- Clifford ( _Clifford the Big Red Dog)_
- Doug ( _Doug_)
- Rolly ( _101 Dalmatians)_
- Pongo ( _101 Dalmatians_)
- Copper ( _The Fox and the Hound_)
- Dug ( _Up_)
- Toto ( _The Wizard of Oz)_

## Famous cartoon dogs

We know that your pooch is the only star in your eyes, from the moment you bring them home. But when it comes to naming your prince or princess, that doesn’t mean you can’t get inspired by **famous dogs from cartoons**, does it?

- Goofy ( _Disney_)
- Pluto ( _Disney_)

- Astro ( _The Jetsons_)
- Huckleberry Hound ( _The Huckleberry Hound Show_)

## Hanna-Barbera dog names

## Looney Tunes dog names

Just like our four-legged friends go looney when you mention the ‘W’ word (rhymes with ‘awkies’), we believe you’ll go crazy for one of these **cartoon dog names** inspired by one of the funniest animations of all time…

- Hector

_Related article: [Blue eyed dog names](https://www.trustedhousesitters.com/blog/pets/blue-eyed-dog-names/)_

Now that we've wrapped up our list of **cartoon dog names**, you should have a good idea which one would suit your pup. But if you're still feeling a little stuck, no problemo, we've got you covered!

Our top tip is to closely observe your four-legged friend's physical features, and spend some time getting to know their unique personality. This will help you come up with names that truly reflect their special traits. For instance, if they're adorable and lazy, you could consider names like Snoopy or Garfield. And if they're white and spotty, then a name from _101 Dalmations_, like Pongo, makes paw-fect sense.

We also suggest drawing inspiration from various sources like nature or even your favorite foods or fairy tales (even though we're talking about dog names here!). But ultimately, the most important thing is to choose a name that feels natural to say and resonates with both you and your Good Boy or Girl. Best of luck in finding the perfect **cartoon dog name** for your furry friend! We're paw-sitive you’ll get it right, first time.

web.title: 40 Famous Movie Dogs We Wish Were Our Pets
web.description:
## Benji in 'Benji'
Filmed in Texas, this 1974 movie features a golden mixed breed dog named Benji who's simply looking for a home.

## Petey in 'The Little Rascals'
Originally portrayed by Pal the Wonder Dog, an American Staffordshire Terrier, he immediately stood out thanks to the ring around his right eye.

## Rin Tin Tin in 'The Adventures of Rin Tin Tin'
Coincidentally, the real-life name of the pup was also Rin Tin Tin Jr., [named after his famous canine father](http://projects.latimes.com/hollywood/star-walk/rin-tin-tin/).
web.markdown:

![Play video](data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" fill="%23ffffff" viewBox="0 0 256 256">%0A%09<path d="M240,128a15.74,15.74,0,0,1-7.6,13.51L88.32,229.65a16,16,0,0,1-16.2.3A15.86,15.86,0,0,1,64,216.13V39.87a15.86,15.86,0,0,1,8.12-13.82,16,16,0,0,1,16.2.3L232.4,114.49A15.74,15.74,0,0,1,240,128Z">%0A</path></svg>)![Video poster](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/famous-dogs-from-movies-1580918090.jpg?crop=1xw:0.84375xh;0,0.156xh&resize=980:*)

We've been independently researching and testing products for over 120 years. If you buy through our links, we may earn a commission. Learn more about our [review process.](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/institute/about-the-institute/a19748212/good-housekeeping-institute-product-reviews/)

Toto from the _Wizard of Oz_. Buddy from _AirBud_. And who could forget about Scooby Doo? Pop culture is full of famously lovable dogs, from main characters to iconic sidekicks. From cartoons to comedies to touching dramas, we think a [dog](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/dog-breeds/) makes any movie better, whether you’re watching an action-packed thriller like _[John Wick](https://www.amazon.com/John-Wick-Plus-Bonus-Features/dp/B00OVFDML4?tag=goodhousekeeping_auto-append-20)_ or you catch yourself shedding a tear during _[Marley & Me](https://www.amazon.com/Marley-Me-Owen-Wilson/dp/B001TGLKB2?tag=goodhousekeeping_auto-append-20)_.

If you’re looking for some inspiration for [movie names for your dog](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/life/pets/a62055242/dog-names-from-movies/) or just for your next favorite movie to watch, these are some of the most recognizable and **famous dogs from movies** **and TV** for true pup culture lovers.

!["men in black ii" premiere](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/frank-the-dog-during-men-in-black-ii-premiere-at-mann-news-photo-1755026884.pjpeg?crop=1.00xw:0.685xh;0,0.0326xh)Gregg DeGuire//Getty Images

1

## Frank in 'Men in Black'

Although Frank the pug looks just like a normal dog, he's actually a talking alien in disguise. His real species is remoolian, but his cute pug appearance and big attitude still earns him his place among other famous movie dogs.

[STREAM NOW](https://go.redirectingat.com/?id=74968X1525078&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hulu.com%2Fmovie%2Fmen-in-black-1500231b-f0df-4e4a-bb98-08013a18ecb7)

![richard gere](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/richard-gere-actor-and-producer-of-the-film-hachi-a-dogs-news-photo-1755027510.pjpeg?crop=0.549xw:0.820xh;0.235xw,0.102xh)Mikki Ansin//Getty Images

2

## Hachiko in 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale'

This movie is based on a real dog named Hachiko, an akita who waited for his owner at the train station every day for nine years after the owner's death. Hachiko became a symbol of unwavering loyalty, and a statue commemorating him sits outside the Tokyo train station he visited every day.

[STREAM NOW](https://go.redirectingat.com/?id=74968X1525078&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftherokuchannel.roku.com%2Fwatch%2F27640b9098cd5db7affba152537b7267%3Fsource%3Dgoogle)

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below

![97th annual oscars arrivals](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/wallace-gromit-figurines-are-seen-during-the-97th-annual-news-photo-1755029431.pjpeg?crop=1.00xw:0.667xh;0,0.156xh)Mike Coppola//Getty Images

3

## Gromit in 'Wallace and Gromit: Curse of the Were-Rabbit'

Gromit is Wallace's best friend and loyal sidekick through their many adventures. From fighting bad guys to enjoying a spot of tea (or a nibble of cheese), these iconic British claymation characters are a nostalgic favorite.

[STREAM NOW](https://www.netflix.com/title/70021655?source=35&fromWatch=true)

![eröffnung der weihnachtssaison 2008, pluto, "disneyland resort p](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/er-c3-b6ffnung-der-weihnachtssaison-2008-pluto-disneyland-resort-news-photo-1755028664.pjpeg?crop=1.00xw:0.666xh;0,0.138xh)Peter Bischoff//Getty Images

4

## Pluto from Disney

Mickey's lovable sidekick is one of the most iconic dogs in pop culture today, even if he doesn't talk. Although he gets less screen time than Mickey or Minnie, the gang just wouldn't be the same without him — and neither would a trip to Disney World.

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below

![Famous Dogs from Movies - Beethoven in “Beethoven”](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/famous-dogs-from-movies-beethoven-1560302450.jpg?crop=0.956xw:0.615xh;0,0.353xh)Universal Pictures / Handout//Getty Images

5

## Beethoven in 'Beethoven'

This gentle giant becomes a loving but mischievous part of the Newton family, looking out for them even when they don't realize it. When an evil vet who wants to experiment on Beethoven accuses the dog of being vicious and says he must be euthanized, the family must figure out how to save their beloved pet.

[STREAM NOW](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B002OKO1GI?tag=goodhousekeeping_auto-append-20)

![Famous Dogs from Movies - Bolt in “Bolt”](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/famous-dogs-from-movie-bolt-1560360341.png?crop=0.760xw:1.00xh;0.0881xw,0)Walt Disney

6

## Bolt in 'Bolt'

Bolt has always believed he's a superhero dog, not realizing that he and his owner, 13-year-old Penny, are actually actors on a TV show and his "powers" are special effects. When Penny is "kidnapped," Bolt sets out on a wild adventure in the real world to try to rescue her.

[STREAM NOW](https://www.amazon.com/Bolt-John-Travolta/dp/B0094KTBK2?tag=goodhousekeeping_auto-append-20)

**RELATED:** [Best Kids' Movies of All Time, From Old Classics to New Favorites](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/life/parenting/g23363159/best-kids-movies/)

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below

![Famous Dogs from Movies - "101 Dalmatians"](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/famous-dogs-from-movies-101-dalmatians-1560371859.jpg?crop=0.803xw:0.536xh;0.126xw,0.0484xh)Dave Hogan / Contributor//Getty Images

7

## Pongo, Perdita, and their Puppies in '101 Dalmatians'

I'm seeing spots! Parents Pongo and Perdita and their many, many puppies first became famous with Disney's 1961 animated movie. Three decades later, it got a live action remake in 1996 and a Cruella-focused movie in 2021. Although we don't condone trying to turn puppies into a fur coat, we do love this movie.

[STREAM NOW](https://www.amazon.com/101-Dalmatians-Live-Action-Glenn-Close/dp/B003QSEYQY?tag=goodhousekeeping_auto-append-20)

![Famous Dogs from Movies - Clifford in “Clifford the Big Red Dog”](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/famous-dogs-from-movies-clifford-the-big-red-dog-1560302961.jpg?crop=0.573xw:0.860xh;0.231xw,0.0561xh)Astrid Stawiarz / Contributor//Getty Images

8

## Clifford in 'Clifford the Big Red Dog'

Formally known as Clifford the Big Red Dog, this pup started as a children's picture book character before becoming an iconic cartoon character and even a live-action movie star. Larger than life and with a friendly personality, Clifford is often described as being similar to a Vizsla, although Clifford's real breed is never revealed.

[STREAM NOW](https://go.redirectingat.com/?id=74968X1525078&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hulu.com%2Fmovie%2Fclifford-the-big-red-dog-494b8d16-5861-428f-b9a6-a0ad8151aa43)

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below

![Famous Dogs from Movies - Max in "How the Grinch Stole Christmas"](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/famous-dogs-from-movies-how-the-grinch-stole-christmas-1560382222.jpg?crop=0.637xw:0.949xh;0.161xw,0.0514xh)Getty Images

9

## Max in 'How the Grinch Stole Christmas'

Jim Carrey's iconic performance as the Grinch is a Christmas classic. But don't let his hilarious acting distract you from the other star: Max the dog. He's loyal even when the Grinch is up to his usual terrible antics and keeps an eye out for his owner.

[STREAM NOW](https://www.amazon.com/Dr-Seuss-Grinch-Stole-Christmas/dp/B000M5NRLC?tag=goodhousekeeping_auto-append-20)

![Famous Dogs from Movies - Scooby-Doo in "Scooby-Doo Where Are You?"](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/famous-dogs-from-movies-scooby-doo-where-are-you-1560383007.jpg?crop=0.786xw:0.944xh;0.109xw,0)Hanna-Barbera//Instagram

10

## Scooby-Doo in 'Scooby-Doo Where Are You?'

Scooby Dooby Doo, where are you? The mystery-busting Great Dane made his first appearance in 1969 and has been a staple of cartoons and movies ever since. He loves a good sandwich with his best friend Shaggy, not to mention a delicious Scooby Snack!

[STREAM NOW](https://www.amazon.com/Scooby-Doo-Where-Are-You-Season/dp/B077Y5TV9Z?tag=goodhousekeeping_auto-append-20)

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below

![Famous Dogs from Movies - Benji in “Benji”](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/famous-dogs-from-movies-benji-1560302598.jpg?crop=0.782xw:0.818xh;0.145xw,0.148xh)CBS Photo Archive / Contributor//Getty Images

11

## Benji in 'Benji'

Filmed in Texas, this 1974 movie features a golden mixed breed dog named Benji who's simply looking for a home. He longs to be part of the Chapman family and when their two young children are kidnapped, the pup doesn't hesitate to step up. Benji helps the humans solve the case, leading the children back to safety, and earning a loving home in the process.

[STREAM NOW](https://www.amazon.com/Benji-Higgins/dp/B079PL2C4H/?tag=goodhousekeeping_auto-append-20)

![Famous Dogs from Movies - Einstein in “Back To The Future”](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/famous-dogs-from-movies-back-to-the-future-einstein-1560360792.png?crop=0.634xw:0.968xh;0.121xw,0.0317xh)backtothefuturetrilogy//Instagram

12

## Einstein in 'Back To The Future'

Everyone can agree that Marty McFly and Doc are the main stars of this futuristic movie with a cult-following. But it's also fair to say that both of them couldn't have altered the future for the better without Einstein's endless support.

[STREAM NOW](https://go.redirectingat.com/?id=74968X1525078&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hulu.com%2Fmovie%2Fback-to-the-future-6dac47d4-aeb9-4ac3-afb5-6c33ef49c86c)

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below

![Famous Dogs from Movies - Fly in “Babe”](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/famous-dogs-from-movies-babe-fly-1560360622.png?crop=0.625xw:1.00xh;0.178xw,0)Universal

13

## Fly in 'Babe'

If an award exists for the best mom dog, it would go to Fly. This Border Collie adopts Babe the pig as her own, teaching him how to herd sheep as a way to prove himself to farmer Arthur Hoggett. When Babe has a rough time, Fly encourages him to keep trying, going against what her partner Rex thinks.

[STREAM NOW](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0026IPAJA?tag=goodhousekeeping_auto-append-20)

![Famous Dogs from Movies - Old Yeller in “Old Yeller”](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/famous-dogs-from-movies-old-yeller-1560303611.jpg?crop=0.658xw:0.860xh;0.197xw,0.0400xh)LMPC / Contributor//Getty Images

14

## Old Yeller in 'Old Yeller'

Grab a box of tissues before you watch this classic dog movie. Released in 1957, the movie tells the story of a stray dog and a young boy who sees potential in him. Slowly, but surely this yellow Labrador mix earns the love of the Coates family, protecting them from all sorts of danger. He doesn't think twice about risking his life for them time after time.

[STREAM NOW](https://www.amazon.com/Old-Yeller-Dorothy-McGuire/dp/B003QSKB2U/?tag=goodhousekeeping_auto-append-20)

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below

![Famous Dogs from Movies - Petey in “The Little Rascals”](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/famous-dogs-from-movies-little-rascals-petey-1560303732.jpg?crop=0.772xw:0.603xh;0.151xw,0.0850xh)CBS Photo Archive / Contributor//Getty Images

15

## Petey in 'The Little Rascals'

Throughout the 1930s, Pete the Pup (Petey) was the most popular canine on the screen. Originally portrayed by Pal the Wonder Dog, an American Staffordshire Terrier, he immediately stood out thanks to the ring around his right eye. The 1994 film recaptures the mischief Petey got into with a handful of rascals.

[STREAM NOW](https://www.amazon.com/Little-Rascals-Travis-Tedford/dp/B00LFF73OU?tag=goodhousekeeping_auto-append-20)

![Famous Dogs from Movies - Pit Bull in “John Wick”](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/famous-dogs-from-movies-john-wick-pit-bull-1560303855.jpg?crop=0.776xw:0.620xh;0.109xw,0.195xh)johnwickmovie//Instagram

16

## Pit Bull in 'John Wick'

John Wick's unnamed pit bull was adopted at the end of the first movie and has become a staple of the franchise ever since. Not speaking a single word, but faithfully running by his owner's side, John can always count on this pup to help him defeat everyone with a deadly agenda.

[STREAM NOW](https://www.amazon.com/John-Wick-Plus-Bonus-Features/dp/B00OVFDML4?tag=goodhousekeeping_auto-append-20)

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below

![Famous Dogs from Movies - Rin Tin Tin in “The Adventures of Rin Tin Tin”](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/famous-dogs-from-movies-the-adventures-of-rin-tin-tin-1560303973.jpg?crop=0.764xw:0.606xh;0.0680xw,0.190xh)Bettmann / Contributor//Getty Images

17

## Rin Tin Tin in 'The Adventures of Rin Tin Tin'

Over 160 episodes, orphan boy Rusty and his German Shepherd dog Rin Tin Tin traveled together to help soldiers establish Western America. Coincidentally, the real-life name of the pup was also Rin Tin Tin Jr., [named after his famous canine father](http://projects.latimes.com/hollywood/star-walk/rin-tin-tin/). metadata.title: 40 Famous Movie Dogs We Wish Were Our Pets
metadata.sailthru.excerpt:
Toto from the Wizard of Oz. Buddy from AirBud. And who could forget about Scooby Doo? Pop culture is full of famously lovable dogs, from main characters to iconic sidekicks. From cartoons to comedies to touching dramas, we think a dog makes any movie better, whether you’re watching an action-packed thriller like John Wick or you catch yourself shedding a tear during Marley & Me.

If you’re looking for some inspiration for movie names for your dog or just for your next favorite movie to watch, these are some of the most recognizable and famous dogs from movies and TV for true pup culture lovers.
